def: OpenAI's open-weight mixture-of-experts reasoning models, released in August 2025 as gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b under the Apache 2.0 license.
practice: Weights ship in MXFP4, so gpt-oss-120b (117B total, 5.1B active parameters) runs on one 80 GB GPU; many inference providers serve it, so compare them on latency and price.
